sector_model: nonfinancial commercial biopharma: product revenue, operating income, FCF after SBC, patent and pricing risk, net cash; acquisition of Soleno (closed 2026-05-18, 2.83B cash) affects comparability
thesis: Neurocrine (Nasdaq: NBIX) sells INGREZZA (tardive dyskinesia and Huntington chorea), CRENESSITY (congenital adrenal hyperplasia, launched December 2024) and, since May 2026, VYKAT XR (Prader-Willi hyperphagia, from the 2.83B Soleno acquisition). Q3 2026 revenue 1,122.7M (+41%); 9M revenue 2,896.2M (+41%); INGREZZA 9M 2,174.8M (+17%), CRENESSITY 9M 547.6M (vs 165.8M). 9M operating income 676.2M (vs 408.2M) after 144.2M of acquisition and divestiture costs; 9M OCF 677.4M. TTM to 2026-09-30: revenue 3,701.7M, operating income 887.1M, OCF 1,065.8M, capex 26.1M, FCF 1,039.7M, SBC 235.1M, GAAP net income 702.5M. At the 2026-11-09 close of 168.86 and 101.22M shares (cover, 2026-10-26) market cap is about 17.09B: 24.3x TTM GAAP earnings, FCF yield 6.1% (4.7% after SBC). Cash and available-for-sale securities were 789.7M with nothing drawn on the new 1.0B revolver (600M borrowed and repaid in the period), so EV is about 16.3B (18.4x TTM operating income). The price appears to assume INGREZZA growth slows under generic and negotiation pressure; what differs is CRENESSITY ramping quickly and VYKAT XR adding a third product, but this record has no peer or history comparison.
counterthesis: INGREZZA is still the profit engine (about 75% of 9M product sales) and faces a Zydus Paragraph IV challenge on INGREZZA SPRINKLE, Teva's AUSTEDO XR, a DOJ civil investigative demand on its sales and marketing (August 2025, no outcome) and the Inflation Reduction Act (applicability to INGREZZA not checked in the 10-Q read). VYKAT XR is already challenged by an Alvogen ANDA (September 2026; the suit triggered a 30-month stay, exclusivities run to a date not read). The acquisition added 2,191.0M of intangibles and 500.6M of goodwill (preliminary allocation) and a pending Soleno securities class action; Q3 included a 52.3M unrealized loss on equity investments; receivables rose 270.5M (957.3M from 686.8M); noncurrent inventory of 177.7M mainly carries acquisition step-up. TTM FCF benefits from strong collections of a fast-growing receivable and a 103.6M income tax asset swing, and Q3 revenue growth may not repeat as CRENESSITY and VYKAT XR comparisons toughen. Stock fell 3.8% on 2026-11-05 then recovered to 168.86.
invalidation: INGREZZA volume turning negative or net price erosion beyond about 5%, CRENESSITY quarterly sales stalling below about 200M, an adverse Zydus or Alvogen ruling, DOJ action with a monetary penalty, or VYKAT XR sales undershooting the acquisition case.
